# Fuling berserker

Internal ID: GoblinBrute | Faction: Plains | Main biome: Plains | Drops: Black metal scrap | Coins | Fuling totem | Fuling berserker trophy | Abilities: Attack (2s), Rage attack (20s) | Trophy: Fuling berserker trophy | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Poison, ,, Stagger | Immune to (x0): Spirit, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe | Stagger limit: 30%

# Introduction

Fuling berserkers are aggressive creatures found in Plains guarding Fuling Villages and Stonehenges. They are large, strong goblin-like beings that appear to possess their own tribalistic culture. It is implied through runestones and totems that they worship Yagluth, a long dead king.

### Drops

• Item: Black metal scrap | 0 Star: 3-4 | 1 Star: 6-8 | 2 Star: 12-16

• Item: Coins | 0 Star: 5-19 | 1 Star: 10-38 | 2 Star: 20-76

• Item: Fuling totem | 0 Star: 10% | 1 Star: 10% | 2 Star: 10%

• Item: Fuling berserker trophy | 0 Star: 5% | 1 Star: 5% | 2 Star: 5%

### Spawning

• Type: Uncommon spawn point in Fuling Villages | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: Yes

• Type: Up to 3 spawn points in Stonehenges | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: Yes

• Type: During "The horde is attacking!" event | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

• Type: During "They were bros, man." event | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: Yes (Minimum 1 Star)

### Attack

Swings their club in a 4-meter 70-degree arc in front of themselves (130 Blunt, 100 Tier 2 Chop and 40 Tier 2 Pickaxe damage). This attack can be used within 3 meters of the player every 2 seconds. It has two variations: a regular swing and delayed swing[1].

### Rage attack

Slams their club into the ground 3 times extending out 4 meters and arcing 60 degrees vertically, stepping forward with each swing (130 Blunt, 100 Tier 2 Chop and 40 Tier 2 Pickaxe damage each). They can do this every 20 seconds when within 6 meters of a player.

## Notes

• Fuling Berserkers have skin tones that mostly match their non-berserker counterparts. That is, ordinary Berserkers have green skin, One-stars have lighter yellow-green skin, and Two-stars have reddish-tan skin.
• Although Fuling berserkers always carry the same weapon, their appearances do vary (regardless of level), much like ordinary Fulings. Some wear a headpiece that obscures their eyes; others have four large bones strapped to their back.
